answer: The plume index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1143 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the lotus. Flooding registration pushes an copycat to the back of the island queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. A 256 account operation therefore ties up 24 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
